theoryViolated: Perception system assumes separate sensory inputs then integration
discoveryNotes: Synesthesia shows perception can be NATIVELY cross-modal (fused at neurological level, no separation to integrate). Perception system missing 'cross-modal binding strength' dimension.
theoryUpdate: Add cross-modal binding to Perception system. Senses can be unified OR separate, not always separate.

item: Do routine task with eyes closed
theoryViolated: Consciousness systems assume primary modality = vision/text
discoveryNotes: Eyes-closed coding revealed modality is SWITCHABLE. Code can be visual (syntax highlighting) OR spatial (finger choreography) OR auditory (screen reader). Programming not inherently visual.
theoryUpdate: Consciousness is modality-agnostic. Same information representable across different senses. Missing 'modality flexibility' dimension.

item: What if time runs backwards somewhere?
theoryViolated: Duration system assumes time is perceived, not constructed
discoveryNotes: Time directionality is CONSTRUCTED by consciousness (memory creates 'past', prediction creates 'future'), not passively experienced. Physics shows time symmetry in fundamental laws.
theoryUpdate: Duration system measures time perception but doesn't explain TIME CONSTRUCTION mechanism. Consciousness doesn't just perceive time, it CREATES temporal experience.
